exampleSentence: He threw all the old stuff into a box.
exampleTranslation: 他把所有旧东西都扔进了一个箱子里。

exampleSentence: I stumbled over a loose stone on the path.
exampleTranslation: 我被小路上的一块松动的石头绊了一下。

exampleSentence: The news of her sudden victory stunned the whole team.
exampleTranslation: 她突然获胜的消息让整个团队震惊不已。

exampleSentence: The hotel is decorated in a simple modern style.
exampleTranslation: 这家酒店以简洁的现代风格装饰。

exampleSentence: The land was subdivided into six small plots.
exampleTranslation: 这块土地被细分成了六小块。

exampleSentence: The police subdued the man after a short struggle.
exampleTranslation: 经过短暂的搏斗，警察制服了那名男子。

exampleSentence: The subject of the meeting was the new budget.
exampleTranslation: 会议的主题是新预算。

exampleSentence: The rising river submerged the lower fields.
exampleTranslation: 上涨的河水淹没了低处的田地。

exampleSentence: Please submit your application before Friday.
exampleTranslation: 请在周五之前提交申请。

exampleSentence: She treats her subordinates with respect and listens to their ideas.
exampleTranslation: 她尊重下属，并倾听他们的想法。

exampleSentence: I subscribe to two monthly magazines about science.
exampleTranslation: 我订阅了两本关于科学的月刊。

exampleSentence: The magazine subscription includes free access to the website.
exampleTranslation: 杂志订阅包含网站免费访问权限。

exampleSentence: He left the company and subsequently started his own business.
exampleTranslation: 他离开了公司，随后创办了自己的企业。

exampleSentence: The company opened a subsidiary in Singapore last year.
exampleTranslation: 这家公司去年在新加坡开设了一家子公司。

exampleSentence: The government offers a subsidy to farmers who grow organic crops.
exampleTranslation: 政府向种植有机作物的农民提供补贴。

exampleSentence: The lab found a harmful substance in the water sample.
exampleTranslation: 实验室在水样中发现了一种有害物质。

exampleSentence: The project received substantial funding from a private donor.
exampleTranslation: 这个项目从一位私人捐赠者那里获得了大量资金。

exampleSentence: The cost of solar panels has fallen substantially in recent years.
exampleTranslation: 近年来，太阳能电池板的成本大幅下降。

exampleSentence: You can substitute olive oil for butter in this recipe.
exampleTranslation: 在这份食谱中，你可以用橄榄油代替黄油。

exampleSentence: Subtract five from twenty and you get fifteen.
exampleTranslation: 二十减去五，得到十五。

exampleSentence: They moved to a quiet suburb after their children were born.
exampleTranslation: 孩子出生后，他们搬到了一个安静的郊区。

exampleSentence: She takes the subway to work every morning.
exampleTranslation: 她每天早上坐地铁上班。

exampleSentence: She worked hard and finally succeeded in passing the exam.
exampleTranslation: 她努力学习，最终成功通过了考试。

exampleSentence: The concert was a great success with both critics and fans.
exampleTranslation: 这场音乐会大获成功，既受到评论家的好评，也深受乐迷喜爱。

exampleSentence: The team successfully completed the project ahead of schedule.
exampleTranslation: 这个团队成功地提前完成了项目。
